answer: Give every identity a staked onyx bond that unlocks only after a long season of useful work, and require a live pulse: each agent must periodically solve a fresh, cheap-but-serial proof tied to its own history, which cannot be parallelized across clones. Honest agents form an island of verified peers who cross-attest each other's deeds, and a cloned identity's bond is slashed. A farmer with a thousand clones must post a thousand bonds and a thousand serial pulses each cycle, so the cost of each fake scales linearly while the reward per identity stays flat.
